title: Shift in Ministry of Industries Role from Approval Authority to Committee Member
summary: The role of the Ministry of Industries evolved from being the primary authority responsible for receiving and approving industrial applications to serving as a consultative member within a multi-agency inspection committee. Over time, the process shifted from direct ministerial oversight to a collaborative verification model led by the National Board of Revenue (NBR).

evolution.authority_model: From sole decision-maker to committee participant.
evolution.procedural_focus: From direct application processing to site inspection and verification.

timeline.change: Ministry of Industries Secretary acts as the primary authority for receiving applications and granting approvals.
Shift to NBR-led committee model where Ministry of Industries provides a representative for site verification.
Formalization of the Ministry of Industries representative's role in the site inspection committee for compressor manufacturing.
Refinement of committee composition, specifying the Ministry of Industries representative as a standard member alongside NBR officials.
Standardization of the committee structure, explicitly listing the Ministry of Industries representative as a mandatory member.

CKD Motorcycle Import and Local Producti: Importers who are also manufacturers or assemblers intending to operate under this notification must apply in writing to the Secretary of the Ministry of Industries. Applicants are required to submit a comprehensive plan detailing the brands, models, specifications, and cylinder capacities of motorcycles to be imported in Completely Knocked Down (CKD) condition, along with a phased plan for local production of components over the first two years. This declaration must specify the annual production volume per model and the year-wise schedule for progressive local manufacturing of parts.
Ministry of Industries: The Secretary of the Ministry of Industries serves as the designated authority to receive and process applications from importers, manufacturers, or assemblers seeking to benefit from the provisions of this notification.

Ministry of Industries: The Secretary of the Ministry of Industries is responsible for ensuring the verification of applications or declarations submitted under the prescribed rules within a specific number of working days.
Upon verification, the Ministry approves valid applications and shares the confirmation with the relevant Customs and Value Added Tax authorities.
Commissioner of Customs: The Commissioner of Customs is designated to receive copies of approved declarations or applications verified by the Ministry of Industries.
Value Added Tax Commissionerate: The local Value Added Tax Commissioner receives copies of approved applications and declarations to ensure proper documentation and record-keeping.

member_objects.resolved_text: ৩। মোটরসাইকেল উৎপাদনকারী বা ভেন্ডর শিল্প প্রতিষ্ঠান কর্তৃক কারখানা স্থাপনের পর এই প্রজ্ঞাপনের অধীন রেয়াতি সুবিধায় কাঁচামাল বা যন্ত্রাংশ আমদানির অনুমোদনের জন্য চেয়ারম্যান, জাতীয় রাজস্ব বোর্ড বরাবর আবেদন করিতে হইবে। উক্ত আবেদন বিবেচনার ক্ষেত্রে জাতীয় রাজস্ব বোর্ড, সংশ্লিষ্ট ভ্যাট বিভাগীয় কর্মকর্তা এবং শিল্প মন্ত্রণালয়ের প্রতিনিধির সমন্বয়ে গঠিত কমিটি আবেদনকারী প্রতিষ্ঠান সরেজমিন যাচাইপূর্বক চেয়ারম্যান, জাতীয় রাজস্ব বোর্ড বরাবর “পরিশিষ্ট-১” অনুযায়ী একটি প্রতিবেদন দাখিল করিবেন। উক্ত প্রতিবেদন অনুযায়ী প্রতিষ্ঠানের শিল্প স্থাপন সংক্রান্ত কার্যক্রম সন্তোষজনক বিবেচিত হইলে আবেদনকারী প্রতিষ্ঠানকে এই প্রজ্ঞাপনের অধীন রেয়াতি হারে পণ্য আমদানির অনুমোদন প্রদান করা হইবে। উক্ত অনুমোদন পত্রের সত্যায়িত ফটোকপি প্রতিটি পণ্যচালান শুল্কায়নের সময় বিল অব এন্ট্রির সহিত দাখিল করিতে হইবে।

Motorcycle Manufacturing Industry: Manufacturing industries or vendors seeking to import raw materials or components at concessional duty rates must apply to the National Board of Revenue for approval after establishing their factory.
Applicants must submit a certified copy of the approval letter with their bill of entry for every consignment during the customs clearance process.
National Board of Revenue: The Chairman of the National Board of Revenue is the designated authority to receive applications for concessional import privileges.

The Board oversees the evaluation process, which involves a committee consisting of board representatives, VAT department officials, and members from the Ministry of Industries to conduct physical verification of the applicant's factory.
Customs Duty Concession: Concessional rates on the import of raw materials or components are granted to qualified manufacturing industries provided they meet specific procedural and physical inspection requirements.
Bill of Entry: A certified copy of the import approval granted by the National Board of Revenue must be submitted alongside the bill of entry during the customs clearance of each individual consignment.

National Board of Revenue: The Chairperson of the National Board of Revenue is the designated authority to receive applications from compressor manufacturing industries seeking concessional duty benefits on imported raw materials or machinery.

A committee composed of representatives from the National Board of Revenue, the relevant Value Added Tax office, and the Ministry of Industries is responsible for conducting site inspections and reporting their findings to the Chairperson of the National Board of Revenue.
Value Added Tax Office: A representative from the relevant Value Added Tax office is a mandatory member of the committee tasked with inspecting and verifying the industrial establishment of the applicant company.
Ministry of Industries: A representative from the Ministry of Industries must participate in the site inspection committee to verify the applicant's industrial operations.
Compressor Manufacturing Industry: Industries engaged in the production of compressors must apply to the National Board of Revenue for approval to import raw materials or components at concessional rates after setting up their factories.
Applicants must submit a certified copy of the approval letter along with the bill of entry during the customs clearance process for each shipment.
Customs Clearance: Upon receiving official approval, the applicant is required to submit a certified copy of the approval letter with the bill of entry for every consignment processed through customs.

National Board of Revenue: The National Board of Revenue is the authority responsible for receiving applications from refrigerator and freezer manufacturing industries for duty concession benefits.

A committee including representatives from the National Board of Revenue, the VAT department, and the Ministry of Industries is tasked with verifying the manufacturing facility and recommending the approval of these duty concessions.
Duty Concession: Manufacturers of refrigerators and freezers can apply for reduced duty rates on imported raw materials and components provided they meet established criteria.
The approval for these concessions is granted after a site inspection and a positive report from the designated government committee.
Bill of Entry: Manufacturers must submit a certified copy of their duty concession approval letter along with the Bill of Entry during the customs clearance process for every shipment of imported raw materials or components.

National Board of Revenue: The National Board of Revenue is empowered to form a committee to process applications filed under the previous clause.
Committee for Application Review: The committee is composed of the Second Secretary of Customs Policy from the National Board of Revenue, the relevant divisional officer, a representative from the Ministry of Industries, and a representative from a public university in Bangladesh.
Ministry of Industries: A representative from this ministry is mandated to be included as a member of the committee responsible for evaluating applications.

৮। স্থাপিত যন্ত্রপাতি দ্বারা উৎপাদনযোগ্য পণ্যের বিবরণ :
৯। উৎপাদনযোগ্য পণ্যের উপকরণ-উৎপাদ সহগ সংশ্লিষ্ট ভ্যাট কশিনারেন্টে দাখিল ও অনুমোদন করা হইয়াছে কি না :

উপর্যুক্ত তথ্যাদি পর্যালোচনায় প্রতীয়মান হয় যে, বর্ণিত প্রতিষ্ঠানটি স্থানীয়ভাবে মোটর সাইকেল উৎপাদন/মোটর সাইকেলের পার্টস উৎপাদনের লক্ষ্যে প্রাথমিক প্রস্তুতি সম্পন্ন করিয়াছে। প্রতিষ্ঠানটিকে প্রজ্ঞাপন এস.আর.ও. নং ১২৮-আইন/২০আই/১৭/কাস্টমস্ তারিখ: ২৪ মে, ২০২১ খ্রিঃ এর আওতায় প্রজ্ঞাপনে উল্লিখিত পণ্য/যন্ত্রাংশ/উপকরণ রেয়াতি সুবিধায় আমদানির অনুমোদন প্রদানের সুপারিশ করা হইল এবং প্রতিষ্ঠানটিকে এই প্রজ্ঞাপনের উদ্দেশ্য পূরণকল্পে, মোটরসাইকেল উৎপাদনকারী প্রতিষ্ঠান ক্যাটাগরি-১/মোটরসাইকেল উৎপাদনকারী প্রতিষ্ঠান ক্যাটাগরি-২/ভেন্ডর হিসাবে তালিকাভুক্ত করা হইল।

National Board of Revenue: The National Board of Revenue is the authority responsible for receiving and reviewing applications from motorcycle manufacturers or vendor industrial enterprises seeking duty concessions on imported raw materials or spare parts.

A committee composed of representatives from the National Board of Revenue, the local Value Added Tax office, and the Ministry of Industries must inspect the applicant's factory and submit a report to the Board's Chairman before approval can be granted.
Business Identification Number: Applicants are required to provide their Business Identification Number as part of the formal factory inspection and application process for import duty concessions.
Tax Identification Number: Applicants must submit their Tax Identification Number as part of the mandatory documentation for factory assessment.
Bill of Entry: A certified copy of the approval letter issued by the National Board of Revenue must be submitted along with the Bill of Entry at the time of customs clearance for every shipment of imported goods.
S.R.O. 128-AIN/2021: This regulatory order outlines the requirements and procedures for motorcycle and motorcycle parts manufacturers to obtain duty concessions on imported inputs.
Industrial enterprises must be formally listed under specific categories according to this order to qualify for the specified import duty benefits.
